LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASS: COLLECTIVE NOUNS/ REFLEXIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you emphasise that you did something on your own?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts
2. use collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASS: COLLECTIVE NOUNS/ REFLEXIVE PRONOUNS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns for Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you emphasise that you did something on your own?
2. Which words do you use to refer to a group of things or animals?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts
2. use collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
